Twemoji attribution
===================

BrainVault uses Twemoji v17.0.3 graphics from the jdecked/twemoji project to render
Unicode emoji consistently across platforms.

Project: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji
Graphics license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License text: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/blob/main/LICENSE-GRAPHICS

The application references the version-pinned SVG assets from jsDelivr at runtime.
